LanguageData.LP_Prayed.stages.0.label: prayed
LanguageData.LP_Prayed.stages.0.description: Poured my heart out to the god at the altar for a while. I feel much steadier.
LanguageData.LP_ServeMyGod.stages.0.label: serving my god
LanguageData.LP_ServeMyGod.stages.0.description: The colony honors the god I believe in as its patron deity.
LanguageData.LP_ServeEnemyGod.stages.0.label: serving an enemy god
LanguageData.LP_ServeEnemyGod.stages.0.description: The colony's patron deity is the sworn enemy of my god. Every day I walk past the enemy's altar.
LanguageData.LP_Forsaken.stages.0.label: forsaken by god
LanguageData.LP_Forsaken.stages.0.description: The god I believe in has abandoned this land.
LanguageData.LP_DawnFavor.stages.0.label: favor of the dawn
LanguageData.LP_DawnFavor.stages.0.description: Lathander's morning light shines on the colony; every day feels like a new beginning.
LanguageData.LP_GuiltyConscience.stages.0.label: guilty conscience
LanguageData.LP_GuiltyConscience.stages.0.description: Tyr's gaze is upon me; everything I have ever done replays before my eyes.
LanguageData.LP_StormJoy.stages.0.label: storm's fury
LanguageData.LP_ConsecratedGround.stages.0.label: hallowed ground
LanguageData.LP_ConsecratedGround.stages.0.descriptio: This land underfoot has been blessed by a god.
